correctness.rationale: For fixed length the scattered 01 count is the sum of one-positions minus binom(t,2), and (t,01) recovers all other order-two counts. The level-k zero/C_k tiling cannot have consecutive nonzero blocks, so the two padded-prefix/suffix families exhaust the factor language and both are realized. At positive fixed t the prefix-family position sum decreases by t per extra trailing zero of the prefix; reversal gives the other injection and t=0 gives a single string. With t=3*2^k/4, the plateau 7n/9 through 8n/9 has 2P/t=19n/27-1. The integer pairs r+u=46n/27 on [22n/27,24n/27] have equal signatures but last ones separated by 2n/27. Different r give different classes. This proves the upper bound and sharpness, not an exact count of doubles.
